changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwpatientwarnings AS SELECT pw.id, pw.patient_id, pw.encounter_id, pw.warning_type, pw.warning, pw.severity, pw.onset_date_undefined, pw.onset_date, pw.by_patient, pw.source_of_information, pw.note, pw.action_taken, pw.status, pw.resolved_by, pw.resolved_date, pw.cancelled_by, pw.cancelled_date, pw.cancellation_reason, pw.created_by, pw.created_date, pw.last_modified_by, pw.last_modified_date FROM public.patient_warnings pw;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwpatientwarnings TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwpatientwarnings FROM report_user;
